# Wain

> Wain is a free, open-source app for running coding agents, on macOS, with Windows and Linux in beta: Claude Code, Codex, pi, fx, Grok Build and OpenCode. It runs the official agent CLIs on your existing subscriptions, many sessions at once, on your computer or on remote machines.

## Features

- Parallel sessions: run many agents at once, each optionally in its own git worktree.
- Orchestration: agents start and message other sessions through the `wain` CLI, and can have a second model review their work.
- Remote machines: run agents on a Linux server or another Mac, driven from the app. Sessions keep running after the app quits.
- Pull requests and issues: checks, review comments and merge beside the chat. Start sessions from GitHub or Linear issues.
- Built-in browser: agents open, test and screenshot your dev server. `wain share` gives it a public link.
- Notch: from any app on your Mac, dictate to a session, read and reply to it, answer its questions and approve tool calls.
- Dictation: on-device speech to text, in the app or from the notch.
- Privacy: your data stays on your machine.

## FAQ

- Is Wain free? Yes. Apache 2.0.
- Is Wain safe to use with a Claude subscription? Yes. Wain runs Anthropic's own Claude Code CLI, so it works within Anthropic's terms.
- Does Wain run on Windows? Yes, in beta: Windows 10 and 11 on x64, as an installer or an MSI. It updates itself like the Mac app.
- Does Wain run on Linux? Yes. The Linux app is in beta: a .deb for Debian and Ubuntu, or an AppImage for other distros with glibc 2.35 or newer, on x64 and arm64. Wain also runs as a server on Linux.

- [Download for Windows (beta)](https://downloads.wainhq.com/Wain_x64-setup.exe)
- [All downloads](https://www.wainhq.com/download): Mac, Windows (beta), Linux (beta: .deb and AppImage, x64 and arm64) and the server.
- [Install on a server](https://www.wainhq.com/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://www.wainhq.com/install.sh | sh`
- [Install on Windows](https://www.wainhq.com/install.ps1): `irm https://www.wainhq.com/install.ps1 | iex` installs the `wain` CLI and server.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/ismatbabirli/wain)
- [Docs](https://www.wainhq.com/docs)
